verdict: Meta ads have been dark for 8 days; two separate issues need resolution.
narrative: Your Meta campaigns stopped running entirely on August 6th and have not spent or delivered a single lead since — this is a confirmed channel blackout, not a gradual slowdown. The 28-day window still reflects 56 leads at a $26.28 cost per lead before the blackout hit, which confirms the account was performing well. Separately, your intake pipeline shows 44 contacts received over the period but zero opportunities or appointments created, meaning leads that did arrive are not being captured downstream — that is being investigated and addressed independently of the ad issue. Meta is being restored as the immediate priority, and the intake gap is being closed in parallel. Once ads are back on, you should expect lead volume to resume at or near the pre-blackout pace.
